fields.title: SICOES tender record
fields.description: One record per Bolivia SICOES tender/procurement process (Convocatoria). A single _error record is emitted instead of payload fields when a page can't be fetched or a session handshake fails.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: 'list:tipo=<convNacional|convInternacional>' for the search run that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which strategy emitted this record (S1-operacion-php, or 'none' on error).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed records (handshake_failed, blocked_or_transient).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

cuce.title: CUCE
cuce.description: Codigo Unico de Contratacion Estatal -- SICOES's unique identifier for this procurement process.

entidad.title: Entity
entidad.description: The purchasing government entity/institution running this process.

tipoContratacion.title: Contracting type
tipoContratacion.description: Bienes, Obras, Servicios Generales, or Servicios de Consultoria.

modalidad.title: Modality code
modalidad.description: SICOES's own modality/procedure code (e.g. ANPP, OF).

objetoContratacion.title: Object of contracting
objetoContratacion.description: The tender's free-text object/description, as published (Spanish).

subastaElectronica.title: Electronic auction
subastaElectronica.description: 'Si' or 'No' -- whether this process runs as an electronic reverse auction.

fechaPublicacion.title: Publication date
fechaPublicacion.description: Date this tender was published on SICOES, dd/mm/yyyy.

fechaPresentacionPropuestas.title: Proposal deadline
fechaPresentacionPropuestas.description: Deadline date for submitting proposals, dd/mm/yyyy.

documentLabels.title: Available documents
documentLabels.description: Labels of the supporting documents SICOES lists for this process (e.g. 'Convocatoria', 'Documento Base de Contratacion'). The PDFs themselves require a CAPTCHA to download directly from the portal -- not fetched by this actor, see CRAWLING_METHOD.md.

tipo.title: Tender scope
tipo.description: convNacional or convInternacional, matching this run's input.

sourceUrl.title: Source URL
sourceUrl.description: The SICOES search page this record came from -- open it in a browser and search by CUCE to view/download the full process file.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns for each tender record -- rows missing a given column render blank.
